title: Design strategies and applications of cyanine dyes in phototherapy
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D3CS00585B, Review Article
Jie Yuan, Hanxue Yang, Wenhui Huang, Shilong Liu, Hua Zhang, Xiaobing Zhang, Xiaojun Peng
An overview of cyanine dye-based phototherapy agents, including the design strategies, relationships between molecular structures and properties, as well as applications in photodynamic therapy, photothermal therapy, and multimodal combined therapy.
